newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Norwood cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Norwood cut to neutral.

text.p: --Rodman & Renshaw said Thursday it downgraded Norwood Promotional Products Inc to neutral from buy following an investor conference call.

--Norwood on Wednesday said it sees Q4 EPS of $0.20-$0.22, lower than the consensus estimate of $0.33. The company also said it expects to take an after-tax charge of about $950,000 or $0.19 per share related to organizational changes.
--Rodman in a report also said with guidance from Norwood it was lowering its FY97 EPS estimates nine percent to $1.30 from $1.43.
--Rodman also said Norwood's acquisitions were proceeding at a slower-than-anticipated pace.
